test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Anmol can complete a piece of work in 25 days. Together with Garima he can complete the same work in 15 days. while Anmol and Aseema working together can complete the same work in 20 days. In how many days can Garima and Aseema working together complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Anmol can complete a piece of work in 25 days.

Anmol and Garima can complete the same work in 15 days. 

Anmol and Aseema working together can complete the same work in 20 days.

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Work done by Anmol in one day = 1/25

Work done by Anmol and Garima in one day = 1/15

Work done by Anmol and Aseema in one day = 1/20

Work done by Garima in one day = (Work done by Anmol and Garima in one day) - (Work done by Anmol in one day)

⇒ 1/15 - 1/25 = (5 - 3)/75 = 2/75

Work done by Aseema in one day = (Work done by Anmol and Aseema in one day) - (Work done by Anmol in one day)

⇒ 1/20 - 1/25 = (5 - 4)/100 = 1/100

Work done by Garima and Aseema in one day = (Work done by Garima in one day) + (Work done by Aseema in one day)

⇒ 2/75 + 1/100 = (8 + 3)/300 = 11/300

**∴ Garima and Aseema working together can complete the same work in 300/11 days.**
